name: Offline Python Builder
description: Build offline Python install repositories with all dependencies
author: FengYu

aiTools.name: offlinepython_doctor
aiTools.description: Diagnose the host Python/pip environment for offline-build readiness.
aiTools.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"executable":{"type":"string","description":"Optional path to a Python executable; omit to auto-detect"}}}

aiTools.name: offlinepython_search_deps
aiTools.description: Search PyPI for a package's available wheels (version/platform/size).

aiTools.name: offlinepython_init_project
aiTools.description: Initialize an offline-python project skeleton (config.json + requirements.txt + README.md) in a writable directory.

aiTools.name: offlinepython_verify
aiTools.description: Verify an offline build output directory against its manifest (checksums, integrity, requirements).

aiTools.name: offlinepython_build_start
aiTools.description: Start an async offline wheelhouse build (pip download) for a project; returns a jobId to poll with offlinepython_build_status.

aiTools.name: offlinepython_build_status
aiTools.description: Poll the status and streamed logs of a build job started by offlinepython_build_start.
